scope: Local preparation incidents; preserve separately from application/runtime gate results.

incidents.symptom: Actual publication guard refused before reservation; diagnostic ENOBUFS/SIGTERM on a 1743309-byte tracked PNG.
incidents.cause: Per-file git show maxBuffer was 1MiB, below a valid required asset size.
incidents.resolution: New ad265 source uses one 64MiB bounded binary git cat-file batch with exact framing/hash/order/EOF checks, retains all1107 pins and adds regression controls. Actual batch41686492 bytes; fresh935 tests and two reviews before successful publication.
incidents.improvement: Exercise the real full pin transport before publication; preserve all assets and reject oversized/invalid framing rather than excluding files.

incidents.symptom: Local read-only receipt extraction raised TypeError before creating output.
incidents.cause: Coordinator utility called renderPg16Evidence without its required binding argument.
incidents.resolution: Read actual exported signature; pass the hash-verified actual CI summary as binding. Corrected utility validated and extracted the existing receipt; no runtime rerun.
incidents.improvement: Read helper signatures and binding contracts before calling them; keep receipt extraction separate from test execution.

incidents.symptom: Dashboard showed Copied, but browser clipboard API returned zero characters.
incidents.cause: UI copy feedback did not establish that text reached the clipboard surface exposed to the agent. Underlying browser clipboard cause was not independently diagnosed.
incidents.resolution: Strict parser refused before writing. Read only the already-visible Connect Framework accessibility text, require one unique staging URL and one publishable key, then save client configuration privately. No secret/service-role key or hidden app state was accessed.
incidents.improvement: Verify copied data, and use visible UI text when clipboard transport is empty; never infer success from button feedback.
